contract.default_operator: L0 -> plain L3 + compare -> light L4; no mandatory L1/L2 screen

contract.no_screen_gate: registry operator route; L0/L3 PASS with per-check existing evidence; ready/validating
contract.diagnostic: mechanism-gap permits evidenced PASS/FAIL and probing/blocked; no acceptance claim; terminal candidates denied
contract.legacy: Explicit screen retains full legacy checks; malformed reports never fall back; known L0/L3 FAIL blocks non-diagnostic collection
contract.unchanged: L0/L3/L4 acceptance, all-kernel denominator, repeatability, shape/weight matching and default-off

history_policy: No rewriting, removal, migration or recollection of historical screen/trace/evidence. No candidate status changes from this workflow deployment.
